rootCauseFix.defect: handler.py's subprocess.run() call passed no cwd=, so the worker.py subprocess inherited the Serverless handler container's own /srv/handler working directory instead of /srv/worker; gfpgan==1.3.8's GFPGANer.__init__ hardcodes a relative model_rootpath='gfpgan/weights' that facexlib==0.3.0's load_file_from_url resolves against the process's actual CWD, causing a cache-miss stdout print ("Downloading: ...") and an unauthorized runtime download attempt that corrupted the single-JSON-document stdout protocol handler.py depends on
rootCauseFix.fix: cwd=WORKER_DIR added to the one subprocess.run() call, where WORKER_DIR = os.path.dirname(WORKER[1]) ('/srv/worker') -- exactly one added keyword argument, no other functional change

approvalPacketStatement: Both required chain images (2-serverless-handler-cwd-fix, 3-volume-mapped-handler-cwd-fix) must be published together with role 1-cli-worker referenced unchanged by its existing immutable published digest. Publishing only one of the two new images is insufficient: the deployed volume-mapped image derives, layer by layer, from the handler layer, so a fix only at the handler layer that is not also rebuilt into a new volume-mapped image would never reach a deployable artifact. Any source, base-digest, or dependency change to either of the two new candidates invalidates this entire readiness record for both. Publication requires a separate, explicit Gate 2 approval -- it is not implied by this build-only readiness review. Publication of this chain does NOT itself authorize Gate 3; a further separate, explicit Gate 3 approval is required afterward, and must reference the new final volume-mapped handler digest once published, not the currently deployed digest (sha256:cd57e507aad2e2230b10784f13a51cb1fd860720037a3c280a5ff7ebfe6db286), which lacks this fix.
